user.title: Washing machine
user.description: Pick the smart plug the washing machine is connected to. Its power reading decides when a wash starts and finishes, and adds up each wash's energy.

data_description.name: Shown on the card and in the push.
data_description.power_entity_id: The smart plug's power reading in watts.
data_description.threshold_w: The machine counts as washing while it draws more than this: above what it draws switched on but idle, below what it draws filling with water. Standby and a finished machine sit below it.
data_description.finish_delay_min: How long the draw must stay below the threshold before the wash counts as finished. The drum rests at a few watts during a programme, so this has to outlast those pauses. The push arrives this long after the last spin.
data_description.min_wash_min: Runs shorter than this (a door lock, a programme cancelled straight away) are ignored: not counted and no push.
data_description.finished_hold_min: After a wash is found to have finished (when the push goes out), the status stays Finished, and the card green, for this long.
data_description.notify_services: Phones that get "Washing done" with the finish time, duration, energy and cost. Leave empty for no push.
data_description.live_activity: On the phones above that use the Home Assistant app: a lock-screen timer from a couple of minutes into a wash, green once it's done (iPhone with iOS 17.2 or later, Android 16). A Labs feature of the app.
data_description.open_path: A dashboard path, for example /lovelace/washing-machine. Leave empty for a push without a link.
data_description.price: Leave empty to use the grid price from Settings → Energy. Each wash's cost is its energy at this price.

abort.already_configured: Another washing machine already uses this power sensor.

error.not_power: This sensor doesn't report power (W or kW).
error.notify_not_found: One of these notify actions doesn't exist. Pick from the list, or type its name without notify.
error.bad_path: A dashboard path starts with /, for example /lovelace/washing-machine.
error.name_required: Give the washing machine a name.

power_entity_missing.title: {name}: power sensor not found
power_entity_missing.description: {name} watches {entity_id}, which doesn't exist any more (deleted or renamed). Washes can't be detected until it's back. Pick the plug's power sensor again in the integration's options (Settings → Devices & services → Washing Machine Monitor → {name} → Configure).

power_entity_disabled.title: {name}: power sensor disabled
power_entity_disabled.description: {name} watches {entity_id}, which is disabled. Washes can't be detected until it's enabled again (Settings → Devices & services → Entities), or pick another power sensor in the integration's options.
